body: Two things are true at once.
The original calculation core, UI layer, seam and three analytical layers (below) do 100% of the real work
— sit alongside as additive scaffolding, wired into almost every live mutation site. Two further subsystems sit alongside all of this, purely additively, touching no calculation formula: the
, an operator-created, first-class-section builder with its own variable registry, template library (incl. an All-in-One dashboard) and per-card display sequencing; and the

(🏭 Factory group), a graph of Business/Delivery/Release-pipeline/Engineering entities linked into the existing SDLC/regulatory artefacts — draft/illustrative, with its own KPI formulas and Excel round-trip. This chapter documents all of it, and is explicit about which parts are actually wired in today versus intentionally left as an opt-in switch (namely: incremental recompute itself staying off by default, and nothing yet subscribing to the two navigation events).
Since v18.5 a sixth engine — the

— sits between the core and the analytical stack, and unlike the five it is not scaffolding: it owns the canonical payback and NPV, drives every horizon from 1 to 10 years, and its arrival deliberately corrected the headline rather than preserving it.

Monte Carlo — perturbs uncertain inputs, evaluates the core per draw, yields the net-benefit distribution (P10/P50/P90, P(net<0), CVaR, sensitivity).
Decision Intelligence — business rules over the
(not a point); confidence-conditional verdict with a coded coherence invariant.
Strategy comparison — 7 delivery strategies as lever vectors over the core under fixed invariants; weighted ranking, radar, one-click apply.
